title: First Light
description: Hold Sprout in sunlight for the first time.
story_unlock: Your creature blinks slowly. Something has changed.

title: First Meal
description: Show Sprout its first patch of grass.

title: Morning Person
description: Care for Sprout two days in a row.
story_unlock: Two days in a row. Sprout notices patterns now.

title: Both Worlds
description: Give Sprout sunlight and grass in the same day.
story_unlock: Sunlight and grass. The full experience.

title: Herbivore
story_unlock: Sprout has opinions about different lawns.

title: Routine
description: Care for Sprout 3 days in a row.

title: Full Day
description: Sunlight and grass in the same day, 5 times.
story_unlock: This is becoming a life together.

title: Week Outside
description: Care for Sprout 7 days in a row.
story_unlock: A full week. Sprout is almost blooming.

title: Deep Root
story_unlock: Sprout knows every shade of green by heart.

title: The Long Game
description: Care for Sprout 14 days in a row.
story_unlock: Two weeks. Sprout is older now, and quieter about it.
